skill.name: flutter-expert

content.value_statement: Flutter projects need sound architecture, responsive interfaces, reliable testing, and platform-specific decisions. This skill provides structured guidance for building and improving cross-platform applications.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Flutter architecture and state management based on project complexity.
Guides responsive, adaptive, accessible, Material, and Cupertino interface development.
Suggests performance improvements for rendering, widget rebuilds, memory, images, and application size.
Plans unit, widget, golden, integration, accessibility, and performance testing.
Explains native platform channels, persistence, APIs, offline synchronization, and secure storage.
Outlines continuous integration, signing, store deployment, monitoring, and multi-platform release workflows.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples but cannot validate behavior on physical devices without project access.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this skill package.
Platform APIs, store rules, and package versions may require current documentation checks.
Generated solutions still require project-specific testing, security review, and performance profiling.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Application
use_cases.description: Select architecture, state management, storage, testing, and deployment approaches for a new Flutter product.
use_cases.target_user: Flutter developers starting a cross-platform application

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Identify widget, rendering, state, memory, accessibility, and testing improvements in an established application.
use_cases.target_user: Technical leads maintaining production Flutter applications

use_cases.title: Integrate Native Features
use_cases.description: Plan platform channels, permissions, secure storage, signing, and release requirements for Android and iOS.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Flutter Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an accessible Flutter screen for [feature] using Dart 3. Include loading, empty, error, and success states.

prompt_templates.title: Choose State Management
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Riverpod, Bloc, and Provider for [application]. Recommend one based on team size, state complexity, testing, and maintenance.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Flutter performance symptoms: [symptoms]. Propose measurements, likely causes, targeted changes, and tests for mobile and web.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production Flutter architecture for [requirements]. Cover modules, data flow, offline synchronization, security, testing, observability, and multi-platform deployment.

output_examples.input: Choose state management for a small application with authentication, settings, and cached API data.
output: Recommendation: Riverpod for explicit dependencies, testable providers, and manageable asynchronous state.
Structure state by feature and keep network and storage logic behind repositories.
Test provider transitions for loading, data, refresh, and failure conditions.

output_examples.input: Outline a performance review for a scrolling product catalog.
output: Measure frame timing, rebuild counts, image decoding, memory growth, and network latency on representative devices.
Use lazy lists, stable keys, cached image sizes, constant widgets, and isolated state updates.
Add performance tests for long lists, rapid scrolling, image failures, and low-memory conditions.

output_examples.input: Plan native biometric authentication for Android and iOS.
output: Define fallback behavior, permission messaging, secure token storage, and platform availability checks.
Separate biometric verification from server authorization and never treat local authentication as a replacement for token validation.
Test enrollment changes, lockouts, cancellations, unsupported devices, and application lifecycle transitions.

best_practices: Provide target platforms, Flutter version, constraints, and current architecture before requesting guidance.
Profile on representative devices and verify generated changes with automated tests.
Include accessibility, error handling, privacy, and deployment requirements from the beginning.
anti_patterns: Do not select state management only because it is popular.
Do not optimize performance without measurements from realistic devices and workloads.
Do not assume one interface, permission model, or deployment process works identically across platforms.

faq.question: Which Flutter versions does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Flutter 3.x and Dart 3.x. Verify package compatibility and current platform requirements before implementation.

faq.question: Can it choose a state management library?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare Riverpod, Bloc, Provider, GetX, and other approaches using your project constraints.

faq.question: Does it support mobile, web, and desktop?
faq.answer: Yes. It addresses shared architecture and platform-specific behavior for mobile, web, desktop, and embedded targets.

faq.question: Can it review an existing Flutter project?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide relevant files, symptoms, constraints, and test results for focused architecture, quality, or performance guidance.

faq.question: Does it execute builds or deployments automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation and deployment guidance, while execution depends on available tools, credentials, and explicit permissions.

faq.question: Can its output replace testing and security review?
faq.answer: No. Validate all changes with project tests, device checks, current documentation, and appropriate security review.
